title: Normalized unit tensor-section restriction equation
statement: For a scheme X and objects u:U -> X and v:V -> X of its small etale site, let g:V -> U be an X-morphism. With rho_g the normalized tensor-section restriction [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial] and epsilon_u, epsilon_v the adjoint structure-module maps [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf], rho_g followed by Gamma(epsilon_v) equals Gamma(epsilon_u) followed by g-sharp on global functions. This is an equality of additive homomorphisms.

source.place: Tags 0096 and 01CA, pullback of the unit; Tag 03DR, equation (35.8.1).

proof.text: Apply the composite adjunction Hom bijection to c followed by epsilon and to pullback of epsilon followed by epsilon. Unit naturality and the normalized composition unit equation make both images the composite structure-sheaf map. Transport along the equality of structure morphisms and evaluate at the top open, using unit naturality and the adjoint structure-map equation. This gives the displayed equality of additive homomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleTensorUnitRestriction_equation {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Etale}
    (g : V ⟶ U) (x : Γ((tensorPullback U.hom).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf), ⊤)) :
    (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit V.hom).app ⊤
        (etaleTensorSectionsRestriction (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g x) =
      g.left.appTop ((tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit U.hom).app ⊤ x)
